title: DLMF 5.2 Definitions: When \Re z\leq 0 , \Gamma\left(z\right) is defined by analytic continuation.
summary: DLMF 5.2 Definitions: When \Re z\leq 0 , \Gamma\left(z\right) is defined by analytic continuation.
body: NIST DLMF section 5.2 (Definitions) says: "When \Re z\leq 0 , \Gamma\left(z\right) is defined by analytic continuation. It is a meromorphic function with no zeros, and with simple poles of residue (-1)^{n}/n! at z=-n . 1/\Gamma\left(z\right) is entire, with simple zeros at z=-n . \psi\left(z\right) is meromorphic with simple poles of residue -1 at z=-n . Pochhammer symbols (rising factorials) {\left(x\right)_{n}}=x(x+1)\cdots(x+n-1) and falling factorials (-1)^{n}{\left(-x\right)_{n}}=x(x-1)\cdots(x-n+1) can be expressed in terms of each other via in which L(n,k)=\genfrac{(}{)}{0.0pt}{}{n-1}{k-1}\frac{n!}{k!} is the Lah number." Equation 5.2.1 on the page has alt text "\Gamma\left(z\right)=\int_{0}^{\infty}e^{-t}t^{z-1}\,\mathrm{d}t,". Equation 5.2.2 on the page has alt text "\psi\left(z\right)=\Gamma'\left(z\right)/\Gamma\left(z\right),". This card records that section's wording and equation alt text. It does not retypeset a formula the alt text did not carry.
